metadata.source: Sinclair et al. (2021) Pre-colonial plant list for the City of Melbourne, ARI
metadata.description: Vegetation coverage parameters by stratum for 12 City of Melbourne vegetation types

Beach and Dunes.description: Sparse shrubland or tussock grassland on sand and shell ridges along coast
Beach and Dunes.notes: High bare sand between plants. Coast Banksia in patches, Coast Tea-tree scrub, or Spinifex grass dominant.

Cliffs and escarpments.description: Patchy shrubland growing on near vertical rocky slopes
Cliffs and escarpments.notes: Very patchy due to steep rocky terrain. Plants in crevices and ledges.

Coastal marshlands and brackish flats.description: Extensive beds of sedges and reeds in areas affected by brackish water
Coastal marshlands and brackish flats.structure_type: Dense marshland dominated by rushes and sedges
Coastal marshlands and brackish flats.notes: Dominated by Sea Rush (Juncus krausii) beds. Frequently waterlogged.

Freshwater wetland.description: Wetland communities including aquatic herbland, tall marsh, and sedgeland
Freshwater wetland.structure_type: Dense sedgeland or reedbed with aquatic plants
Freshwater wetland.notes: Dominated by Common Reed (Phragmites) or rhizomatous sedges. Significant open water with aquatics.

Grasslands and Woodlands on fertile plai.description: Open woodland dominated by River Red Gum over rich grassy layer
Grasslands and Woodlands on fertile plai.notes: Iconic River Red Gums widely spaced. Dense Kangaroo Grass dominates. Very high forb diversity.

River banks and creeklines.description: Riparian woodland with River Red Gums, shrubs, and dense herbaceous layer
River banks and creeklines.structure_type: Woodland with dense shrubby and herbaceous understorey
River banks and creeklines.notes: River Red Gums overhang water. Dense thickets of Swamp Paperbark, Sweet Bursaria. Overlapping layers.

Saltmarsh.description: Low herbs and succulent shrubs in saline areas
Saltmarsh.structure_type: Low sparse to dense succulent herbs and low shrubs
Saltmarsh.notes: Variable by sub-type. Glasswort shrubs in hypersaline areas. Often patchy with bare salt pans.

Saltwater wetland.description: Mangroves or submerged sea-grass beds in saline water
Saltwater wetland.structure_type: Low mangrove woodland or submerged sea-grass beds
Saltwater wetland.notes: Grey Mangrove shrubland on intertidal mud, or submerged sea-grass beds. Mostly open water.

Swamp scrub.description: Dense scrub of Swamp Paperbark over sedges
Swamp scrub.notes: Dominated by very dense Swamp Paperbark. Nearly impenetrable thickets. Murray (1843): 'jungle that rose up like a wall'.

Wet heathland.description: Dense low shrubland in infertile sandy soils that are often waterlogged
Wet heathland.structure_type: Low dense heathland or tall paperbark scrub
Wet heathland.notes: Dense heath shrubs on waterlogged sand. Scented Paperbark forms tall dense scrub in wetter areas.

Woodlands and forests on sedimentary hil.description: Tall open forest dominated by Yellow Box and River Red Gum over species-rich grassy layer
Woodlands and forests on sedimentary hil.structure_type: Tall open forest over diverse grassy woodland
Woodlands and forests on sedimentary hil.notes: Yellow Box and River Red Gum. Very species-rich - highest diversity vegetation in CoM. Wildflower displays in spring.

Woodlands and heathlands on sand.description: Eucalypt woodland with dense diverse shrubby understorey on nutrient-poor sand
Woodlands and heathlands on sand.structure_type: Open woodland over dense heath understorey
Woodlands and heathlands on sand.notes: Eucalypts over dense heath. Silver Banksia, Drooping She-oak, many Acacias. Very dense shrub layer. Bracken prominent.
